independence_declaration.text: The reviewer is assigned before P0-02 and is separate from the executor and the reserved non-reviewer parser-author role. The reviewer must not author the parser; collect or modify raw evidence; modify raw, normalized, manifest, threshold, Schema, or frozen artifacts; or resolve source conflicts by manual number edits. At P0-07 the reviewer performs only read-only schema review, clean canonical replay, hash verification, and gate review. Replay inputs, exit code, hashes, and conclusions belong only in reviewer-attestation.json after replay. The parser-author role remains unassigned at this freeze and may be filled only by a recorded non-reviewer identity before parser authorship begins.
